verdicts.title: A family of Hecke eigenforms for Drinfeld modular forms of arbitrary rank
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We aim to provide a family of Drinfeld-Hecke eigenforms given in terms of a determinant of twisted Eisenstein series. Our main tool is the theory of vectorial Drinfeld modular forms, previously introduced by Pellarin [18] and extensively studied by Pellarin [19] as well as in his joint work with Perkins [20] in the rank two setting. We will develop this theory in the present paper for the arbitrary rank setting by using a particular representation.

verdicts.title: Zero Excess and Minimal Length in Finite Coxeter Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $\mathcal{W}$ be the set of strongly real elements of $W$, a Coxeter group. Then for $w \in \mathcal{W}$, $e(w)$, the excess of $w$, is defined by $e(w) = \min\{\ell(x) + \ell(y) - \ell(w) \; | \; w=xy, x^2 = y^2 = 1\}$. When $W$ is finite we may also define $E(w)$, the reflection excess of $w$. The main result established here is that if $W$ is finite and $X$ is a $W$-conjugacy class, then there exists $w \in X$ such that $w$ has minimal length in $X$ and $e(w) = 0 = E(w)$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns excess and minimal length in finite Coxeter groups ('there exists w in X such that w has minimal length... and e(w) = 0'), which is unrelated to modular forms, eigenforms, or communication complexity rank.
